title: Solvatochromic multi-colour fluorescence driven by thiol-type ESIPT in a 1-mercapto-naphthaldiimide compound
abstract: A novel thiol (SH)-type excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) imide compound was synthesized, showing large Stokes-shifted fluorescence. Multiple emissions sensitive to solvent polarity demonstrated distinctive environmental response.
